filters.predictivos.tooltip: Advanced mathematical models: Markov Chain, Nash Equilibrium, and Regression to the Mean.
filters.predictivos.dataInfo:
Advanced mathematical models:
• Markov Chain: Analyzes transition probabilities between consecutive states from past draws.
• Nash Equilibrium: Models the optimal strategy to maximize mathematical expectation against popular selections.
• Regression to the Mean: Statistical principle where numbers with extreme frequencies (very cold or hot) tend to stabilize towards their historical average.
